notes: - **Report a problem from Settings › General (the About card) or the tray; you see exactly what's sent.** Describe what went wrong and press Send. Under **Show what's sent** you can read the version, Windows details, a summary of switches and engine names and the recent log lines that go with it, with keys, names and your user folder taken out. Nothing is sent until you press Send, and you get a report ID. See [Reporting a problem](/docs/troubleshooting/#reporting-a-problem).
